newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal's INE sees 1996 inflation below target.
newsitem.headline: Portugal's INE sees 1996 inflation below target.

text.p: Portugal's National Statistics Institute (INE) said it expected average annual inflation in 1996 to stand at 3.1 percent, below the target of 3.25 percent set by the government and the Bank of Portugal.

"In the absence of any serious disruption, the year-on-year rate should continue to fall in the coming months and permit the average annual inflation rate to stand at 3.1 percent in 1996," INE's monthly report said.
